title: ccp_vectors_match: Rust step-3 explicit gate removal post-g7p7 reconciliation
description: Follow-through from b7z9.30.3/knb6: the regenerated ccp16.json vectors (density 9/10 -> sf 12) exposed that rust adaptive_sf_select still gated step 3 behind 'explicit' params (pre-2a.8-reconciliation divergence) — ccp.py and the generator apply step 3 unconditionally. Fix: remove the explicit gate from step 3 (density > DENSITY_HIGH -> +2, unconditional per spec 2a.8); step 4 keeps its explicit gate (the default path uses the adaptive_sf() table form); ccp_vectors_match asserts the select form against the vectors (the table-only adaptive_sf() legitimately diverges for density > 8: floors at 11 vs pseudocode 12); adaptive_sf_and_rebalance_matches_spec's density-12 case updated to the reconciled select result (12). Python ccp.py already unconditional — parity holds.
close_reason: Landed: removed the 'explicit' gate from AdaptiveSFSelect step 3 (density > DENSITY_HIGH = 8 engages +2 unconditionally) so the Rust form matches python ccp.py, the vector generator, and spec 2a.8 exactly — resolving the ccp_vectors_match failure (11 vs 12) exposed when the regenerated ccp16.json vectors synced. Step 4 keeps its explicit gate (the only SF-decreasing step — conservative direction, per the security reviewer); ccp_vectors_match now asserts the select form against the vectors (the table-only adaptive_sf() form legitimately diverges for density > 8 — floors at 11 vs pseudocode 12 — and stays covered by its own unit tests); adaptive_sf_and_rebalance_matches_spec's density-12 case updated to the reconciled select result (12). Verified: lichen-core 367+2+1 green, clippy --all-features -D warnings clean, fmt clean. Reviews: correctness/security/edge-cases (kimi-k3) all PASS — correctness re-simulated all 11 ccp16 vectors bit-exactly under the new logic and confirmed in-tree callers are test-only; security verified no SF-downgrade path opened and the assigned_sf clamp gap remains tracked by worker6-5m15 (pre-existing, not worsened).
